name: com.notfiction/news
title: notfiction: is it real?
description: Is it real? Check claims and links against dozens of newsrooms. News scored by how many report it.

tools.name: check_claim
tools.description: Check whether a rumor, headline, claim or link (X/TikTok/YouTube post, article) is being reported by real newsrooms. Compares it with what 37 newsrooms (BBC, NYT, Fox News, NPR, Guardian, CBS, NBC and more) are reporting now and have reported since November 2026, flags satire sites and old news, and returns a verdict, the matching coverage with links, and a public answer page. Use when a user asks "is this real?", "is this fake news?", or shares a link to check. It reports coverage; it is not a fact-check.

claim.description: The claim in plain words, a headline, or a link to check.

tools.name: search_news
tools.description: Search current and recent news stories by person, place, topic or headline words. Each result says how many independent newsrooms reported it (the newsroom score), who reported it first, and links to the original reporting.

query.description: Names, places or a few headline words.

tools.name: top_stories
tools.description: The biggest news stories right now, ranked by how many independent newsrooms are reporting them and how recent they are. Optionally one section. Includes the facts the coverage agrees on when available.

section.description: top, latest (every new report), news (U.S. & world), entertainment, sports, business or tech.

tools.name: get_story
tools.description: Everything about one story: every outlet reporting it in the order they published (with links), who was first and who confirmed it, the facts the coverage agrees on, where outlets differ, and claims only one outlet makes.

id.description: The story id from another tool, or its notfiction.com/s/<id> link.

tools.name: news_briefing
tools.description: A short briefing: the ~10 biggest stories that 3+ newsrooms are reporting, each with the facts their coverage agrees on. Good for "what's going on today?"

tools.name: newsroom_track_record
tools.description: Which newsrooms break stories first that others then confirm. With no newsroom: the 30-day ranking. With a newsroom name: its 90-day record and recent scoops.

tools.name: real_or_fiction_game
tools.description: Today's Real or Fiction? game: five headlines, some real news and some from satire sites. Returns the headlines (not the answers) and the link to play.
